verdict.rationale: Vue's docs list a first-party Quick Start and Tooling Guide (titles only in this pack). A community user confirms the official vue-cli scaffolds projects with the official router and store "very easily", and another welcomes Vite for simpler development. One user complains about spending days configuring builds, which tempers confidence but does not concretely contradict official scaffolding. Missing for 10: doc content showing the actual scaffold-and-run commands, evidence for the "few minutes" timing claim, and recent hands-on corroboration of the current starter.
